title: Qui-Gon Jinn
description: A venerable Jedi and maverick of the Order, Qui-Gon Jinn had a deep connection to the living Force and followed it wherever it led him. Even if that put him on the outs with the Jedi Council. Trained by Count Dooku, he took on Obi-Wan Kenobi as a Padawan and served as an unorthodox master to the young man. He let his instincts and the Force guide him on Tatooine, leading him to a young boy named Anakin Skywalker. Qui-Gon believed the boy to be a vergence in the Force and the key to prophecy that would bring balance to the Force. Unfortunately, the Council disagreed.
